data.name: Khulaid

data.long_meaning: The name Khulaid is derived from the Arabic word 'khulud' which means morning dew. This name is associated with the gentle, refreshing and rejuvenating effects of morning dew. It symbolizes the purity and innocence of new beginnings. The name Khulaid carries the meaning “Morning Dew” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khulaid usually hope their child will grow to embody morning dew and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Khulaid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Morning Dew.”
